title: Worktree creation doesn't populate project_dir pins — wrong-tree dispatch class still open
wanted_capability: Fleet/workflow worktree creation should emit `pin:*.project_dir=<worktree>` (and the workflow op its arc worktree) so a confused model passing the wrong tree gets a refusal with explanation — killing the wrong-tree class completely. The pin flavor of the ToolArgDefaults grammar is implemented and tested (w11 skinny-brodex build); only the daemon-side population at worktree-creation time is missing. Design contract: design/bro-harness/tool-arg-defaulting.md step 5 full form — bump its lifecycle to partial when picking this up.
missing_primitive: Daemon-side pin emission in fleet cockpit + workflow WorktreeCreate paths
notes: Item 1 of thread-55d51135 (which stays OPEN as the umbrella — items 2 ambient-default expansion is operator-decision-gated on §3.1 scope semantics and stays thread-resident).
resolution_note: Fixed in f513534 (worktree-scope-cluster branch): AmbientContext::tool_arg_defaults() emits pin:*.project_dir=<canonical worktree root> at one mechanical choke point whenever dispatch cwd is a managed worktree (cockpit-managed roots OR linked-git-worktree structure — covers fleet, agent, and workflow WorktreeCreate trees). Plain repo dispatches never pin. Workflow resume branch now carries the table (legacy spawn_task dropped it). Design doc tool-arg-defaulting.md bumped to lifecycle: partial per the gap's instruction. project defaulting remains decision-gated (gap-ae22a6b2).
